verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a graphics card, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is not a capability a GPU would ship; this is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships automation version control: G-Assist (system tuning) and ComfyUI workflows are unrelated features and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
